approved_list.document: Form W-2 from each employer (yours and, if filing jointly, your spouse's), including any employer you left during the year, plus any corrected Form W-2c
Business income and expense records (income records, receipts, mileage logs, and bank or payment app statements), including any Forms 1099-NEC received
Any Form 1099-K received from a payment app, online marketplace, or card processor (collect it even if you think it is wrong)

Form 1099-DA (if received), plus the client's own records for every digital asset sold, exchanged, spent, or used to pay fees: date and time acquired, cost basis, date disposed, and proceeds or fair market value in U.S. dollars
Provider name, address, taxpayer ID, and amount paid

Charitable gift records: for each cash gift, a bank or card record, canceled check, or receipt or letter from the charity showing its name, the date, and the amount; for any single gift of $250 or more, a written acknowledgment from the charity stating the amount and whether goods or services were given in return; for noncash gifts, records supporting Form 8283 when over $500 and a qualified appraisal when Form 8283 requires it

follow_up_questions.question: Did you itemize deductions on last year's return instead of taking the standard deduction?
